candidate_selection: none; one geometry and one solver attempt

engineering_thresholds.scope: one-case inter-plane consistency only; not absolute convergence, H1, complete 32G validation, or production admission

floquet_extraction.basis: official full-period E/H Floquet least squares; +z/-z and TE/TM

deembedding.kz: official passive square-root branch and extractor sign convention

historical_comparison: cross-height comparison remains separate from historical EXT02 repeatability; never replace old truth

metric_definitions.absolute_order: per-order modal power divided by the official incident-source power normalization
metric_definitions.amplitude: report magnitude and relative magnitude difference by wavelength/order/direction/polarization
metric_definitions.complex_state: ||c_far_ref-c_near_ref||2 / ||c_near_ref||2 across seven propagating orders and both polarizations
metric_definitions.routing: per-order propagating modal power divided by total propagating modal power, no fitted normalization
metric_definitions.total_power: sum of propagating modal powers at each plane before post-hoc scaling

added_diagnostic_plane.actual_sample_and_mesh: unknown until materialized and read back
added_diagnostic_plane.name: EXT02_POSTNP_DIAG_Z2000

planes.z_rule: de-embed from actual sampled z, not nominal z

secondary_diagnostics.dispersion: continuous-medium kz de-embedding approximates FDTD numerical dispersion; report local mesh spacing at both planes
secondary_diagnostics.evanescent: report separately including upward decay and fit; not far-field power and no propagating-state threshold
secondary_diagnostics.least_squares: residual, rank and condition number by wavelength/order/plane
secondary_diagnostics.normalization: official source normalization only; no post-hoc fitted scale
secondary_diagnostics.periodic_endpoints: first/last x and y field closure; extractor trapezoidal endpoint half-weights
secondary_diagnostics.poynting: independent plane-integrated Poynting flux versus modal power

significance_and_phase.mask: per wavelength, include coordinate iff |c_near|^2 / sum_propagating(|c_near|^2) >= 1e-4
significance_and_phase.weak_amplitude: report all amplitudes and unmasked metrics; exact-zero phase is undefined and excluded by mask

solver_scope: one independent EXT02 diagnostic case only
stop_rule: if the frozen Runner cannot accept the independent case/monitor overlay through its supported authority schema, do not invoke solver-capable entry; report exact interface limitation
